build_latency_augmented_criterion: build a fairseq training criterion that augments label smoothed cross entropy with latency loss for simultaneous translation
create_config_dataclass: create a LabelSmoothedCrossEntropyCriterionLatencyAugmentConfig dataclass to configure latency weights, types, and gather methods
compute_latency_loss: compute latency loss from model attention alignment using expected delays and variance across attention heads
register_criterion: register the latency_augmented_label_smoothed_cross_entropy criterion with fairseq using the register_criterion decorator
reduce_metrics: reduce logging outputs to log average latency, delays variance, and latency loss as scalar metrics
